questions.q: The latency budget for a tracking loop is set by:
options: The median of the first 10 runs
questions.explain: One slow frame in the middle of a maneuver is a lost target.

questions.q: The first quantization step on a GPU with almost no loss of accuracy:
questions.explain: FP16 is usually free in terms of accuracy.

questions.q: PTQ was calibrated on daytime frames only. The expected consequence:
options: Higher accuracy at night because of noise
questions.explain: Activation ranges differ under other conditions.

questions.q: Why is the held-out set split by flight rather than by frame?
options: It's faster to label and train that way
questions.explain: Nearly identical frames leak between train and test.

questions.q: After 20 minutes of operation p99 doubled. The most likely cause:
options: A memory leak in the model weights
questions.explain: Profile inside the enclosure and for a long time.

questions.q: A model layer the accelerator doesn't support:
questions.explain: It runs on the CPU and can eat the whole gain; the engine profiler shows this right away.

questions.q: In a search for people, it makes sense to shift the detector threshold toward:
questions.explain: The operator will check the false alarms.

questions.q: What must be written to the log of every flight with ML on board?
questions.explain: Without the version, investigating an incident is impossible.

questions.q: The tracking loop budget is 80 ms. The onboard detector profile:
questions.fragment: n=300 mean=41.2 p50=33.8 p95=96.4 p99=211.7 max=402.3 budget_ms=80 ok=False over_budget_frac=0.07
options: The average fits, but the tail (p95/p99) doesn't: 7 % of frames take longer than the budget, find the source
over_budget_frac = 0.07 is perf_counter timer error, not real slow frames
p50 = 34 ms means the model is underloaded and can be replaced with a heavier one
Everything is fine: the budget is checked against the average, and 41 ms is less than 80
questions.explain: The loop budget is checked against p99: slow frames in the middle of a maneuver lose the target.
